mapper.select:
SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ as courseSeq , A.TITLE , A.CATEGORY_ID , B.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , A.PRICE , A.BADGE , A.DISPLAY_YN AS displayYn , A.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_COURSE A INNER JOIN TB_CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.REG_DT BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND dateadd(day, 1 , CAST(#{endDate} AS date))
AND A.TITLE LIKE #{title} + '%'
SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ , A.TITLE , A.CATEGORY_ID , A.PRICE , A.BADGE , A.DISPLAY_YN , A.INTROD , A.MAIN_IMG , A.CONTENT_DETAIL , A.REG_DT FROM TB_COURSE A WHERE A.COURSE_SEQ = ${courseSeq}

SELECT A.COURSE_DTL_SEQ , A.COURSE_SEQ , A.UNIT_TITLE , A.DISPLAY_YN , A.SORT , A.FILE_SEQ , B.FILE_NAME , B.FILE_URL , B.FILE_SIZE , B.THUMBNAIL_URL FROM TB_COURSE_DETAIL A OUTER APPLY ( SELECT F.FILE_SEQ , F.FILE_NAME , F.FILE_URL , F.FILE_SIZE , F.USE_YN , F.THUMBNAIL_URL FROM TB_FILES F WHERE F.FILE_SEQ = A.FILE_SEQ ) B WHERE A.COURSE_SEQ = ${courseSeq}
SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ , A.FILE_NAME , A.FILE_URL , A.FILE_SIZE , A.THUMBNAIL_URL , A.USE_YN FROM TB_FILES A WHERE A.COURSE_SEQ = ${courseSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FILES ( FILE_SEQ , CON_SEQ , FILE_NAME , FILE_URL , FILE_SIZE , THUMBNAIL_URL , USE_YN ) SELECT FILE_SEQ , #{courseSeq} , FILE_NAME , FILE_URL , FILE_SIZE , THUMBNAIL_URL , 1 FROM TB_FILES_TEMP WHERE GROUP_KEY = #{groupKey}
mapper.select:
SELECT A.BoNode , A.BoNode.ToString() AS BoNodeText , A.BoNode.GetAncestor(0).ToString() AS ParentNode , A.BoLevel , A.BoNum , A.BoCate , dbo.GetCodeNm('BoCate', A.BoCate) AS BoCateNM , A.LinqSeq , A.Subject , A.UserId , CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), A.RegDt, 121) AS RegDate , CASE WHEN A.BoLevel = 1 THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BOARD B WHERE B.BoNode.ToString() LIKE A.BoNode.ToString() + '%' ) -1 ELSE 0 END AS CommentCnt , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.TB_FILES AS BM WHERE BM.CON_SEQ = A.BoNum) AS FileCnt , COUNT(*) OVER() AS BoRowCnt FROM dbo.TB_BOARD A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.RegDt BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND dateadd(day, 1 , CAST(#{endDate} AS date))
AND A.Subject LIKE #{title} + '%'
SELECT boA.BoNum , boA.BoCate --카테고리 , boA.Subject --제목 , boA.Content --내용 , '' AS ImageList FROM dbo.TB_BOARD AS boA WHERE BoNum = #{BoNum}
mapper.insert: {call BOARD_ADMIN_INSERT( #{BoNum, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{BoCate, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{BizCode, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{LinqSeq, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{Subject, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{Content, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserPwd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserName, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserEmail, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserHomepage, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserContact, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserIp, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string} )}
